title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: From the quiet floors of Horn Library to the collaborative hubs in Olin Hall, these ten campus environments offer the best settings for focused work and group projects.

cards.title: Silent Zone on the Third Floor
cards.subtitle: Quiet study area in Horn Library
cards.notes: Head to the top floor for strictly enforced quiet study. It features individual carrels and a distraction-free environment for deep focus.
cards.short_summary: The designated quiet study floor of the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: The entire third floor of the library is reserved for quiet study.
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; silent study rules apply.

cards.title: Greenery in the Bala Iyer Garden
cards.subtitle: Four-season garden in Babson Commons
cards.notes: Study surrounded by natural light and plants in this indoor garden. It is a bright, airy space perfect for reading between classes.
cards.short_summary: A light-filled indoor garden space within the Babson Commons addition.
cards.evidence_claim: One of the most stunning aspects of the new Babson Commons is its centerpiece: the Bala Iyer Garden, a four-season garden.
cards.source_title: Babson Commons Opens at Horn Library
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible within the Commons building.

cards.title: Graduate Quiet Study at Olin
cards.subtitle: Quiet study space in Olin Hall
cards.notes: Visit the third floor for a dedicated quiet zone. It is the primary home for graduate students seeking a silent workspace.
cards.short_summary: A quiet study area located on the third floor of the graduate school hub.
cards.evidence_claim: Enjoy the peace and quiet of the “quiet study” space on the third floor of Olin Hall.
cards.access_notes: Primarily used by graduate students; quiet hours observed.

cards.title: Collaborative Work in Global Lounge
cards.subtitle: Study area in Reynolds Campus Center
cards.notes: Use the comfortable furniture and open layout for group meetings. It is a high-energy spot with easy access to printers and snacks.
cards.short_summary: A spacious, social study lounge located in the heart of the campus center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Global Lounge is where you can hang out or study for classes, with access to free printers.
cards.access_notes: Open during campus center hours; good for group work.

cards.title: Maker-Style Study at the Foundry
cards.subtitle: Collaborative space at Weissman Foundry
cards.notes: Bring your laptop to the large work tables for a creative study session. This space encourages transdisciplinary collaboration.
cards.short_summary: An open-concept workroom designed for prototyping and collaborative projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Collaborative Workroom is our largest space and is open to the public for innovative collaboration.
cards.access_notes: Open 10am-9pm weekdays; open to Babson, Olin, and Wellesley students.

cards.title: FME Projects at Schlesinger Center
cards.subtitle: Collaboration space in Park Manor West
cards.notes: Utilize the conference rooms and amphitheater seating for team projects. It is specifically designed for first-year entrepreneurship work.
cards.short_summary: A modern collaboration hub located within the Park Manor West residence hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The center features an amphitheater, classroom, and collaboration spaces for students in the FME course.
cards.access_notes: Located in a residence hall; primarily for first-year student use.

cards.title: Peer Support at the Resource Center
cards.subtitle: Learning center in Horn Library
cards.notes: Find a table near the writing or math centers for quick access to peer tutors. It is a dynamic environment for active learning.
cards.short_summary: A ground-level hub offering academic support and collaborative study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Resource Center offers students a dynamic learning environment with faculty and peer support.
cards.source_title: Babson Horn Library Renovations | Finegold Alexander Architects
cards.access_notes: Centrally located on the ground level of the library.

cards.title: Casual Study in the Grad Lounge
cards.subtitle: Lounge area in Olin Hall
cards.notes: Relax on the ground floor with comfortable seating and TV access. It is a great spot for low-intensity studying and socializing.
cards.short_summary: A social and casual study space for graduate students on the ground floor of Olin Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Graduate Student Lounge, located on the ground floor, is where you can relax or study.
cards.access_notes: Open to graduate students; located on the ground floor.

cards.title: Basement Breakouts at PM Central
cards.subtitle: Group study rooms in Park Manor Central
cards.notes: Book one of the basement rooms for a private group session. These rooms are tucked away from the main residential traffic.
cards.short_summary: Dedicated group study rooms located in the basement of Park Manor Central.
cards.evidence_claim: A large band practice room and group study rooms are located in the basement of Park Manor Central.
cards.access_notes: Accessible to residents; rooms can be reserved via EMS.

cards.title: Reservable Classrooms in Gerber
cards.subtitle: Study rooms in Gerber Hall
cards.notes: Reserve a classroom for large group study sessions when classes aren't in session. Use the EMS system to secure your spot.
cards.short_summary: Academic classrooms available for student study reservations during off-hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Bookable classrooms include Gerber Hall 101, 102, 103, 213, 214, and 215 via ems.babson.edu.
cards.access_notes: Requires reservation through the Virtual EMS system.
